correctness.rationale: The nine labelled vertices and twelve nearest-neighbour edges define a 12-bit cube; spanning trees are precisely connected acyclic 8-edge subsets. I independently generated all C(12,8)=495 candidate subsets and found 192 trees, four center-adjacent edge incidences 112 and eight perimeter incidences 136. An integer 12-stage Walsh transform over all 4096 sign patterns gave precisely the stated 15 absolute-value frequencies: zeros=1186, nonzeros=2910, minimum positive 4, maximum 192. The parity identity N_odd(S) congruent to sum over included-edge tree counts mod 2 proves 4-divisibility; mask 116 attains W=4, giving sharp condition number 192/4=48. A second complete Walsh transform of the nonzero-support indicator gave kernel numerator L1 sum 40976 and ratio 40976/4096=2561/256. General averaging of any projection over 4096 translations preserves the invariant range, the idempotency on that range and does not increase endpoint norm, producing the unique Fourier support projector; hence global minimality. This is exact finite verification, not a higher-grid-size theorem.
